meta.name: testing
meta.description: Unit/integration testing standards for RedisInsight using Jest and Testing Library: test structure, the `renderComponent` helper, faker for test data, mocking patterns, and `waitFor` instead of fixed time waits. Use when writing or modifying any `*.spec.ts` or `*.spec.tsx` file, when adding component or slice tests, when debugging flaky tests, or when the user mentions jest, testing library, faker, or test patterns.

copy.tagline: 按规范编写和调试前端测试
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 RedisInsight 项目中编写或修改测试用例
copy.tagline_en: Write and debug frontend tests following standards

howto.what: Claude 会按照 RedisInsight 项目的测试标准编写或修改测试，包括使用 AAA 模式、faker 生成测试数据、renderComponent 辅助函数、waitFor 异步等待，避免固定超时。
howto.when: 当用户编写或修改 `*.spec.ts` 或 `*.spec.tsx` 文件，添加组件/切片测试，调试不稳定测试，或提及 jest、testing library 等关键词时触发。

say.text: 用 faker 生成测试数据，别用手写固定值。
帮我写一个组件的单元测试，用 renderComponent 辅助。
确保异步等待用 waitFor，不要用固定超时。
say.note: Claude 会用 waitFor 或 findBy 查询。

howto.what_en: Claude follows RedisInsight's testing standards (Jest + Testing Library) when writing or modifying tests: uses AAA pattern, faker for test data, the `renderComponent` helper, `waitFor` instead of fixed timeouts, and proper mocking patterns.
howto.when_en: When the user writes or modifies any `*.spec.ts` or `*.spec.tsx` file, adds component/slice tests, debugs flaky tests, or mentions jest, testing library, faker, or test patterns.

say_en.text: Use faker to generate test data, not hardcoded values.
Write a component unit test using the renderComponent helper.
say_en.note: Claude follows the shared renderComponent pattern.

say_en.text: Use waitFor for async waits, not fixed timeouts.
say_en.note: Claude uses waitFor or findBy queries.
